# QuickKOL

> QuickKOL is an AI-assisted creator marketing platform for brands and marketing teams. It helps turn a campaign brief into creator discovery, profile analysis, shortlists, and personalized outreach.

The website includes product information, pricing, creator marketing guides, and free planning tools. Core platform coverage includes YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X (Twitter); available data and features vary by plan and platform. Website workflow previews use example data and simulated progress.

## Product and support

- [Home](https://www.quickkol.com/): Product capabilities and campaign workflow previews.
- [About](https://www.quickkol.com/about/): The QuickKOL product story and team context.
- [Pricing](https://www.quickkol.com/pricing/): Plans, included usage, and credit billing.
- [FAQ](https://www.quickkol.com/faq/): Answers about discovery, AI Agent, subscriptions, and credits.
- [Contact](https://www.quickkol.com/contact/): Product questions and support; support@quickkol.com.

## Guides and tools

- [Blog](https://www.quickkol.com/blog/): Creator marketing guides with publication dates, team attribution, and source links.
- [Creator rate calculator](https://www.quickkol.com/tools/creator-rate-calculator/): Estimate a creator's content fee range using planning assumptions.
- [Campaign cost calculator](https://www.quickkol.com/tools/influencer-campaign-cost-calculator/): Estimate a campaign budget or the creator mix a budget can support.
- [Invoice generator](https://www.quickkol.com/tools/invoice-generator/): Create and export invoices.

## Optional

- [Terms of service](https://www.quickkol.com/terms.html): Service conditions and responsibilities.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.quickkol.com/privacy.html): Information handling and privacy contacts.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.quickkol.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public page URLs.
